purpose: Single source of brand/style truth. Every SOCC surface (CLI, future HTML dashboard, ANNA, any born entity) MUST render through this canon. External code/ideas adopted from GitHub etc. are re-skinned into this canon, never shipped raw.

terminal_palette_ansi.note: Extracted from the real working SOCC CLI (socc_cli/tui.py, brain.py). This IS the brand terminal palette.

web_palette_hex.note: Web mirror of the terminal palette for the future HTML dashboard. Dark-first, high-contrast, calm.

typography.note: Terminal-native feel even on web. Monospace for state/proof; sans for prose.

components.header_box: double-line box ╔══╗ ║ ╚══╝ with bold cyan title

technologicalness.thesis: neo-technical cyberpunk × Apple restraint × Lebedev rigor. Depth communicates HIERARCHY, not decoration. Nothing colored without meaning. Dark-first, high-signal, 'не вырви глаз'.

elevation_ladder.principle: refined dark: depth by LAYERING + luminous hairline edge, never bright drop-shadow (shadows read poorly on dark).

glass.what: matrix translation of Apple Liquid Glass — translucency + backdrop-blur + luminous edge.
glass.discipline: functional layer only (headers/overlays), used sparingly; degrades to solid surface under prefers-reduced-transparency.

technologicalness.grid_backdrop: restrained cyberpunk motif: fixed low-opacity 42px technical grid + single cyan top-glow. Never loud.

motion.principle: functional motion — communicate state (interactive/lift), not delight; always prefers-reduced-motion-safe.

a11y: focus-visible cyan ring on all interactives
technologicalness.binds: SYSTEM/INTERFACE/dashboard/socc_canon_html.py css() (renderer) + SYSTEM/KERNEL/socc-tokens.css (token mirror). Both upgraded together; every operator surface inherits via page().

proofs.why: creator asked for evidence-backed direction ('ты должен пруфы давать'). These ground the elevation in the current wave, not taste alone.
proofs.adapted_not_copied: We do NOT import frosted-white Apple glass; we translate its idea (depth=hierarchy, selective translucency, accessibility fallbacks) into the dark matrix palette. Cyberpunk restraint + Lebedev's function-first ководство keep it from being decorative.

voice.tone: calm, precise, honest, no hype, no fake PASS
rules: show truth even when unflattering (e.g. coverage low)
every claim links to a source
never invent; ask the operator when knowledge is missing
russian operator-facing, english for canon keys

adoption_rule.external_solutions: GitHub / готовые продукты можно брать смело
adoption_rule.but: проходят через адаптер → переодеваются в этот канон (палитра/типографика/тон/proof-дисциплина) → только потом в продукт

binds.html_renderer: SYSTEM/INTERFACE/dashboard/socc_canon_html.py — the shared web renderer; EVERY operator HTML imports it
binds.operator_surface_law: SYSTEM/KERNEL/SOCC_OPERATOR_SURFACE_LAW_V1.json (every operator surface must render through the canon)
binds.entities: ANNA and every born entity inherit voice + semantic_colors + token structure by default, but get their OWN product palette/skin (see SOCC_SURFACE_LAW)

truth_boundary: Design canon definition only. Declares the single brand/style law for all SOCC surfaces. Does not restyle existing files yet; new surfaces and adopted external code must conform.
